extension.summary: Cast YouTube from your phone to Kodi, played through yt-dlp
Przesyłaj YouTube z telefonu do Kodi, odtwarzane przez yt-dlp
extension.description: Kodi shows up as a TV in the YouTube app: pick it from the cast menu, or link it once with a TV code. Every video is resolved by yt-dlp, which the add-on keeps current by itself, and played by InputStream Adaptive from YouTube's HLS manifest -- streamed, with seeking and quality switching, nothing downloaded first. No other add-on is needed for casting. Anything else in Kodi can play a video through it with plugin://plugin.video.ytdlpcast/?video_id=ID

Kodi pojawia się jako telewizor w aplikacji YouTube: wybierz go w menu przesyłania albo połącz raz kodem TV. Każdy film rozwiązuje yt-dlp, który dodatek sam aktualizuje, a odtwarza InputStream Adaptive z manifestu HLS YouTube -- strumieniowo, z przewijaniem i zmianą jakości, bez wcześniejszego pobierania. Do przesyłania nie jest potrzebny żaden inny dodatek. Inne elementy Kodi mogą odtworzyć przez niego film adresem plugin://plugin.video.ytdlpcast/?video_id=ID
extension.news: v2.0.0 - Receives casts from the YouTube app itself: TubeCast is no longer needed - A phone linked with a TV code stays linked across restarts - Detailed cast log in kodi.log (search for "cast/"), yt-dlp's own messages included - Renamed to "yt-dlp Cast"
